description: A radiotap capture utility that outputs pcap dumps, handling wireless network frames, with ring buffer management, signal handling, and packet filtering.

methods.name: check_type
methods.description: Checks if the network interface supports radiotap by verifying hardware address family.

methods.name: set_promisc
methods.description: Enables or disables promiscuous mode on the network interface.

methods.name: sig_dump
methods.description: Signal handler to trigger dumping ring buffer to file.

methods.name: sig_teardown
methods.description: Signal handler to stop capture and clean up.

methods.name: write_pcap_header
methods.description: Writes pcap global header to output file.

methods.name: write_pcap_frame
methods.description: Writes a packet frame with timestamp to pcap file.

methods.name: ringbuf_init
methods.description: Initializes a ring buffer for packet storage.

methods.name: ringbuf_add
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the ring buffer with current timestamp.

methods.name: ringbuf_get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific entry from the ring buffer.

methods.name: ringbuf_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for the ring buffer.

methods.name: msg
methods.description: Logs messages either via syslog or stderr depending on daemon mode.
